verdict.rationale: Notte supports repeatable, scripted workflows rather than one-shot prompts. It mixes deterministic scripting with AI steps (notte-gh-2), generates workflow code from the CLI that you then edit (notte-docs-30, notte-docs-8), and deploys scripts as serverless Functions you can invoke and schedule as API endpoints (notte-docs-2, notte-docs-26), with ready-made templates available (notte-docs-36). Loops, conditionals and parameters are only implied by writing code; no first-party workflow-composition primitives are documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of loop/conditional control flow, documented parameterized inputs for Functions, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-step workflow composition.
